evidence_spans: The 3×3 μm2 AFM micrograph (Fig. 1i) exhibits terrace-like surface undulations with a RMS roughness of only 0.43 nm
(i) AFM height map acquired over a 3 × 3 μm² scan window for the as-grown surface
The surface morphology of the as-grown heterostructures was characterized using atomic force microscopy (AFM, Bruker, USA)
CLM-MAT-0450.statement: The RMS surface roughness of the as-grown heterostructure is 0.43 nm.

extra_quotes: ScAlN/GaN heterostructures were epitaxially grown on 4H-SiC substrates using a self-customed plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy (PA-MBE) system.
Temperature-dependent Hall measurements were performed from 2 to 300 K using the van der Pauw configuration.
